tasks.query: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135) OR replay_timer_group IN (920132,920133,920134,920135) OR request_timer_group IN (920132,920133,920134,920135) OR title IN ('Unrest in the Metal Mines','Chaos in the Stonequarry','An Alternative Explanation','Overheated Production')

task_activities.query: SELECT * FROM task_activities WHERE taskid IN (920132,920133,920134,920135)

tasksets.query: SELECT * FROM tasksets WHERE taskid IN (920132,920133,920134,920135)

reward_sets.query: SELECT * FROM reward_sets WHERE reward_set_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135)

reward_options.query: SELECT * FROM reward_options WHERE reward_set_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135)

reward_option_entries.query: SELECT * FROM reward_option_entries WHERE reward_set_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135) OR reward_id IN (3839201321,3839201341)

reward_sources.query: SELECT * FROM reward_sources WHERE reward_set_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135) OR (source_type=2 AND source_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135))

reward_source_entries.query: SELECT * FROM reward_source_entries WHERE (source_type=2 AND source_id IN (920132,920133,920134,920135)) OR reward_id IN (3839201321,3839201341)

rewards.query: SELECT * FROM rewards WHERE reward_id IN (3839201321,3839201341)
